text: In accordance with Part H, Section 22 of the Board of Health Procedures By-law, the Board of Health elects a Chair at its first meeting in each calendar year. All members, including the incumbent, are eligible for election.

The Board of Health: 1. Elected Councillor Joe Mihevc as Chair of the Board of Health for a term of office starting on January 22, 2018 and ending on November 30, 2018, and until a successor is appointed.
